alternativeConsidered.tradeoff: This avoids a new local reviewer supervisor, but still requires five-role immutable attempt lineage, atomic bounded retry, protected enrollment, host-derived QA identity, draft-to-ready/review wait recovery and worker verdict/integration consumers. Four records separate enrollment from those cross-cutting durability changes. The operator is choosing that separation, not being told a three-record route is impossible.
